learning_contract: 结构化critique保存固定维度向量、每条建议的dimension/target/edit、输入paper修订与逐轮diff；维度允许比较不自动提供真实评审正确性，需校准/证据/严重回归门禁。
目标须五维全部达到约定阈值；plateau仅停止探索的策略，不能当论文已合格。停止原因target/plateau/budget/error需分开，源码把plateau也叫converged应中文明确只是停止。
源码plateau检查窗口相邻mean差<=epsilon，负向退化也被认plateau；均值可掩盖evidence下降，保每维差与硬条件，不得宣称已自动捕获所有维度回归。
比较同paper输入的确定性critic无随机噪声；修订改变输入导致分数变化不等统计噪声。两段低增益不能证明真实研究再无进展，window/epsilon需任务标定。
结果paper、scores与trace须指向同一修订。目标先检查，plateau也在reviser前；budget最后轮则执行reviser后返回此前评分，需重评分或明确scores属于pre-revision。
建议数不等执行diff数；源码suggestions_applied先等len(suggestions)，no-op/不存在target与plateau未执行都可能误计。Reviser原位修改paper，保不可变历史snapshot或hash，不能把Protocol当纯函数隔离保证。
deterministic_score按正文长度、figure/cite数量、originality_tag及Method/Related Work非空打分；append x/自称high/添加占位引文能刷高，不能代表清晰、新颖、证据或方法有效。
维度键恰好五项、score类型有限且0..10、round/target/epsilon/window严格校验；critic suggestions内含未知edit/不存在section要有终态而非静默。可选权重改变目标语义，不能替代证据维度硬约束。
source_code_and_tests_audit: Critique.mean平均所有provided keys；target只按DIMENSIONS get缺项0，无严格固定keys/有限/范围，extra keys可影响plateau；targetscore/epsilon bool/NaN/negative缺校验。
_plateau检查最近window+1的均值差>epsilon才继续，下降或NaN差可被判plateau；没有逐维回归reject。
run target→plateau→reviser；budget最后轮先reviser再return旧critique，scores与finalpaper错位，target/plateautrace0或planned count不保证真实apply。
源码critic固定建议threshold8，loop.target_score可选9/10时suggestion可能提前清空导致belowtarget plateau，不能声称配置任意target均收敛。
reviser返回同一paper对象，unknown edit/坏target silent，无真实diff日志；评分引用/图只数refs未查内容/资源，append x纯合成。

quiz.original: Why does the critic score across five fixed dimensions instead of returning a freeform paragraph?
original_options: Because models cannot generate paragraphs reliably
Because the reviser only accepts JSON
Because LaTeX requires a score field
Because a fixed vector lets the harness detect per-dimension regressions across rounds
quiz.source_marked_answer: Because a fixed vector lets the harness detect per-dimension regressions across rounds
quiz.source_explanation: A fixed dimension vector turns critique into structured data the harness can compare across rounds. Freeform criticism is unverifiable; vectors make regressions visible.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 固定五维可记录逐维变化，但源码停止仅看mean，并未自动门禁所有回归；评分内容还要证据校准。

quiz.original: In what order does the loop check stop conditions at the end of a round?
original_options: Plateau, then target, then budget
Budget, then plateau, then target
Whichever fires first by random tie-break
Target, then plateau, then budget
quiz.source_explanation: Target met wins (the work is done). Then plateau (no more progress is achievable). Then budget (hard cap). The order makes the result deterministic when more than one condition could fire.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 源码目标先，平台后，预算最后；target成功、plateau止步与budget耗尽分别解释，不把所有停止叫学术合格。

quiz.original: Why does plateau detection require two consecutive flat rounds rather than one?
original_options: Because the model returns nondeterministic scores
Because deterministic scoring still has noise per round; one flat round is not enough signal
Because the dataclass requires a list
Because the dashboard expects two points
quiz.source_marked_answer: Because deterministic scoring still has noise per round; one flat round is not enough signal
quiz.source_explanation: Even a deterministic scorer's output changes round to round depending on which suggestions were applied. Requiring two flat rounds filters that noise.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 两段低增益是抗单轮扰动的政策，不是噪声或真实停止进步的证明；固定输入确定性评分无随机噪声，下降也会满足源码plateau。

quiz.original: What does the reviser receive as input each round?
original_options: The raw LaTeX source
A model-generated paragraph
The full Critique object including scores
The paper and the list of Suggestion records
quiz.source_marked_answer: The paper and the list of Suggestion records
quiz.source_explanation: Reviser.__call__ takes (paper, suggestions). Each Suggestion carries a dimension, target section, and an edit instruction. The reviser does not see scores. That separation lets either side be swapped without touching the other.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: Reviser收paper与Suggestion列表；每条dimension/target/edit是结构合同，但source原位修改且可能no-op，需真实diff与snapshot。

quiz.original: What does the trace contain for each round?
original_options: Just the final paper draft
Only the convergence verdict
The model prompt and completion
Round number, score vector, mean, suggestions applied, verdict
quiz.source_marked_answer: Round number, score vector, mean, suggestions applied, verdict
quiz.source_explanation: The trace is the per-round event log. Dashboards render it as a score-over-time chart; the next stage reads it to decide whether the branch is worth keeping.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: trace有round/scores/mean/suggestions_applied/verdict；源码applied常只是建议数，plateau未修也计计划数，不能称已应用全部。

quiz.original: A critic that keeps emitting suggestions that never improve any score will produce which terminal verdict?
original_options: converged, because suggestions were applied
target, because the budget hides the bug
plateau or budget, because the harness will catch the lack of progress
An exception, because the loop crashes
quiz.source_marked_answer: plateau or budget, because the harness will catch the lack of progress
quiz.source_explanation: Either plateau (two flat rounds) or budget (hard cap) fires. Both verdicts surface the bug. The loop never silently succeeds.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 无增益会触发plateau或budget，但源码plateau状态也叫converged，中文须明示只是停止，非完成质量目标。

lessons.test_purposes: keys/range/noveltytag、建议belowtarget、同源toy均值提升、target、plateau/budget、trace形状、append与tag变化；无逐维退化/NaN或final revision alignment校验

diagrams.meaning_and_boundary: Mermaid flowchart分别画paper到五维score/suggestions、Critique字段、target→plateau→budget；sequence画critic→reviser→check，但实际代码先target/plateau后reviser。最后注册chCritic固定五组上升4轮分数，第4轮全部>=8却仍动画plateau badge；与target优先合同不一致，非真实评分，向量不自动检查回归。

learning_contract: 每hypothesis有唯一ID、branch、payload版本，每结果回链调度中的真实ID/branch、attempt与终态。源码Result可伪指别branch且无严格type/range校验，必须在更新stats前核。
UCB按branch有效反馈mean+c sqrt(ln N/n)，n为该branch已完成的有效反馈数、N为所有有效反馈数；0反馈用探索政策。pending、failed/timeout和valid0reward分开记录，零reward正常增加n，错误不能永远不计attempt且继续+inf。
来源同时派发时未更新pending；A1,A2,B1且slots2可都选A，因为它们completed runs仍0、同为inf按队序胜出。需每branch的pending/预留策略或明确允许重复，quiz“每branch先试一回再重复”不能普遍保证。
Picker排序和prune门禁分开：源码prune按completed最低数量后mean低于floor，非UCB上界塌缩。剪枝会终止未来探索，噪声/早期差样本可能误删，阈值及证据依据另定，不能保证科研收益。
asyncio只为可让出eventloop的runner提供并发，CPU阻塞工作不因async签名变并行。slots限制in-flight task数，不限制runner内部额外资源；task需per-job deadline/cancel/cleanup与资源预算。
max_experiments实际在dispatch时增加，是派发attempt上限非所有已成功实验数。max_seconds只在派发/结果处理边界检查，asyncio.wait无timeout、drain直接await，可超期任意久甚至永久挂；quiz“hard wall cap”错误。
所有in-flight终态统一result/error/timeout/cancelled账本，主循环异常有trace但不增branch.runs，drain异常静默且不触发prune/expand，边界终态政策不一致。计数/预算/结果需要覆盖每个dispatch。
paper.trigger在branch mean跨threshold后每branch一次，是候选写作事件，不是科学结论认证；已触发后mean下降/后续prune须policy，不能以trigger证明最终质量。
expander按单result reward>=threshold而非branch mean决定调用；需验证followup ID/parent/samebranch/payload、去重与queue大小/预算。prune后仍可被expander塞回同branch，run末无inflight时可能queue仍有不可调度项却标queue_empty。
seeded共享NumPy RNG与asyncio.done集合遍历顺序不足保证所有trace/派发顺序固定；可固定结果归并顺序和per-ID随机种子，持久化stats/queue/pending/actual budgets与replay状态，不只seed。
source_code_and_tests_audit: ucb_score用completed stats，run的experiments_run却按dispatch attempts计；失败不增n/mean、有效reward0才增，语义应各自记录。
_pick_next无pending，零runinf多并发可重复同branch，slot1交错测试不覆盖。
max_seconds无wait timeout或cancel，drain无bound；启动deadline已到可仍报告queue_empty但queue非空，负/NaN/Inf参数无validation。
Result不核task hyp.ID/branch/finite/unitreward，stats可被错误结果改写，rewardNaN可能污染picker/mean。
main normalresult prune/expand/error，drain onlystats/trigger/result.drain且error静默；账本计数不同，taskcancel不是Exception全兜策略。
prune后同次highresult仍可expand重新加pruned branch；expander无ID唯一/queuemax/samebranch/预算核。
asyncdelay只是调度fixture，fixedbase rewards不是真实验收益；sleep测试不证CPU加速。

quiz.original: Why does the scheduler use UCB scoring instead of always picking the current best branch?
original_options: Because the queue cannot be sorted otherwise
Because asyncio requires UCB
Because UCB is faster to compute
Because greedy picks never explore; UCB balances exploitation with exploration
quiz.source_marked_answer: Because greedy picks never explore; UCB balances exploitation with exploration
quiz.source_explanation: Greedy locks onto the first lead. Uniform never exploits. UCB picks the leader while reserving capacity for less-explored branches via the sqrt(ln N / n) term.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: UCB显式加探索bonus，避免只按当前均值的greedy；科研奖励真实/可比与统计条件另核，不保证最有价值成果。

quiz.original: What score does a branch with zero completed runs receive under UCB1?
original_options: Positive infinity, so untried branches are always picked first
The mean reward of all other branches
Zero
The exploration constant c
quiz.source_marked_answer: Positive infinity, so untried branches are always picked first
quiz.source_explanation: The lesson assigns +inf for runs=0. This guarantees every branch is tried at least once before any branch is revisited.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 源码n=0为inf，但并发无pending保留，同branch多个零完成任务可连续派发；everybranch先一次保证仅相应串行队列条件。

quiz.original: How does the scheduler keep multiple slots busy?
original_options: It uses asyncio.create_task per dispatched hypothesis and awaits FIRST_COMPLETED on the in-flight set
It runs the runner in a thread pool
It blocks the event loop on a sleep
It uses multiprocessing
quiz.source_marked_answer: It uses asyncio.create_task per dispatched hypothesis and awaits FIRST_COMPLETED on the in-flight set
quiz.source_explanation: Each dispatched hypothesis becomes a task. The main loop waits on FIRST_COMPLETED so a finished slot is freed immediately and another hypothesis is dispatched.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: create_task加FIRST_COMPLETED保持可让出eventloop的任务并发；阻塞CPU工作不自动并行，完成处理及drain须统一终态。

quiz.original: When does the scheduler emit a paper.trigger for a branch?
original_options: Every time a result lands on that branch
When the prune floor is hit
Only at the end of the run
On the first result whose branch mean meets or exceeds the paper threshold, and only once per branch
quiz.source_marked_answer: On the first result whose branch mean meets or exceeds the paper threshold, and only once per branch
quiz.source_explanation: The trigger fires once per branch, the first time the branch's mean crosses the threshold. The paper_triggered flag on BranchStats prevents repeats.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: branch平均到threshold且flag未置才trigger一次，未给论文真实性/后续质量保证，需记录之后退化或prune。

quiz.original: What happens to a branch whose mean reward stays below the prune floor after the minimum-runs threshold?
original_options: Nothing; UCB will eventually pick another branch
The reward floor is lowered automatically
The branch is marked pruned and remaining hypotheses on that branch are removed from the queue
The scheduler raises an exception
quiz.source_marked_answer: The branch is marked pruned and remaining hypotheses on that branch are removed from the queue
quiz.source_explanation: Pruning removes the branch from future scheduling. Pruning is separate from the picker: UCB ranks, pruning culls.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: prune按minimum valid完成数与mean floor移除queue中的该branch；不是按UCB上界裁剪，pending仍会完成且expander可重塞。

quiz.original: Which two budgets does the scheduler enforce as hard limits?
original_options: Memory and CPU
paper triggers and prune count
slots and queue depth
max_experiments (total runs) and max_seconds (wall clock)
quiz.source_explanation: Both fire as stop reasons. max_experiments caps total work. max_seconds caps wall time. The trace records which one stopped the run.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 派发数max_experiments有限，max_seconds仅停新派发的软界、等待/drain未超时不能称hard wall cap；需要逐任务timeout/cancel和终态账本。

lessons.test_purposes: UCB0inf/相同run均值/低runbonus，slot1先三branch，sleep并发、一次trigger、followup/prune、派发数预算/宽松1秒deadline、syntheticrange；无并发零run重复/失败/NaN/resultidentity/hang/drainpolicy

diagrams.meaning_and_boundary: Mermaid queue→slots→resultbus→scorer→queue+paper、Hyp字段、create_task/firstcompleted回流均是架构意图；实际Hyp只id/branch/payload，runs/rewards在BranchStats。chScheduler UCB1.9/1.4/.6全固定，pruned依据说boundcollapses而代码按mean floor；图不执行UCB/真实runner/预算。

learning_contract: 代码真实按文件import54 PaperWriter、55 CriticLoop、56 IterationScheduler；50 hypothesis、51 experiment-code、52 metricparser、53 results-store并未调用，seed与runner是本地stub。不能称前七模块全部真实集成。
loader使用importlib.util.spec_from_file_location和三个独立模块名避免main重名，但代码仍修改sys.path、写sys.modules并执行模块顶层；静读不调用loader，唯一名不等完全不污染命名空间。
seed三分支，reward是56 NumPy固定base+noise+sleep，未跑任务真实训练/论文实验/LLM；挑最高mean是候选选择，有selection bias且不同样本数需不确定性/独立验证，不能reward越高就科学新颖。
Picker无trigger抛NoTriggerError，全orphan trigger抛BestResultError；部分orphan被静默过滤、未检duplicate/finite/positive runs/pruned，需严格报告而不是悄悄丢分支。
MiniPaper original_tag按reward .8/.6划档、正文初始固定，critic占位扩写/引文自动加分；critic返回stopped或plateau也继续mini_to_full与writer，没有必须target、逐维证据/真实实验门禁。
mini_to_full造Synthesised作者/Source c*引用与figs/branch.pdf路径字符串，无查文献真实存在、无生成该PDF、无建立真实实验结果图。原critic figure_refs被替换成只Results一图；引用存在于bib字段不等出处支持主张。
writer用MockProseGenerator，报告paper_manifest/tex/bib仅协议产物；full paper与mini及critic分数版本关系需明确，writer若重新生成prose不能沿用原draft评分，须root54行为核验。
相同seed的test只比较branch、reward六位精度与section IDs，没有比完整manifest、内容SHA、bib/figure有效性或trace。绝对路径及wall秒数本来会不同，不能声称整个report同字节确定。
各stage并非自动严格shape gate，critic budget/plateau不是异常、scheduler swallowed errors不使流水整体失败；需逐stageschema/版本/hash/终态验收，失败止后续保诊断且不伪装所有情况typederror。
run_demo默认mkdtemp创建产物未cleanup，重复write同目录幂等/原子/资源界限需另定；持久恢复不只把小JSON放盘，还需实际输入输出与state版本、可信取回/完整性、已发生成本和任务许可。此轮不实际写论文或编译。

quiz.original: What is the demo's job in this lesson?
original_options: To benchmark the scheduler against a baseline
To call a real language model on each branch
To replace the earlier lessons with a single new framework
To compose the primitives from the earlier lessons through plain Python imports
quiz.source_marked_answer: To compose the primitives from the earlier lessons through plain Python imports
quiz.source_explanation: The demo is a composition test. Each stage exists in its own lesson. The demo imports them and wires the report. No new framework, no new abstractions.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 该demo真实组合54–56接口，50–53仍inline stub，未实现整套科学实验管线或测LM效果。

quiz.original: Why does the lesson load earlier lessons via importlib instead of a normal package import?
original_options: Because importlib is faster
Because each earlier lesson is a standalone code/ folder, not an installed package; importlib loads them by file path
Because asyncio requires importlib
Because the lessons share a module name and would collide
quiz.source_marked_answer: Because each earlier lesson is a standalone code/ folder, not an installed package; importlib loads them by file path
quiz.source_explanation: The lessons are not installed packages. Each ships a main.py inside its own code/ folder. importlib.util.spec_from_file_location loads them by path without polluting the global module namespace.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 按路径加载独立code/main.py及独立模块名避重名；仍修改sys.path/sys.modules并执行顶层，不能称全无namespace影响。

quiz.original: How does the best-result picker decide between branches when more than one triggered a paper?
original_options: It picks the branch with the highest mean reward, breaking ties alphabetically by branch id
It picks the branch with the most experiments run
It picks at random for fairness
It picks the first triggered branch
quiz.source_marked_answer: It picks the branch with the highest mean reward, breaking ties alphabetically by branch id
quiz.source_explanation: Highest mean wins. Ties break on branch id so the demo is deterministic. Random would defeat the determinism test.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 候选trigger里按最高mean、字母branch打破tie；均值必须来自合法同协议反馈并考虑样本数/选择偏差，最高不等已证实。

quiz.original: What error does the picker raise when the scheduler reports zero paper triggers?
original_options: ValueError
It returns None
PaperValidationError
NoTriggerError, which short-circuits the demo before the writer runs
quiz.source_marked_answer: NoTriggerError, which short-circuits the demo before the writer runs
quiz.source_explanation: NoTriggerError is the typed failure mode. Returning None would let the writer run on a malformed input and break later with a less actionable error.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 空trigger抛NoTriggerError；全orphan为BestResultError，而partialorphan静默略过需纠正，测试没有证明整个pipeline所有故障均短路。

quiz.original: Why does the demo run twice with the same seed in the determinism test?
original_options: To catch a memory leak
To assert that the picked branch, reward, and paper section ids are identical across runs
To exercise asyncio twice
To prove that the scheduler is fair
quiz.source_marked_answer: To assert that the picked branch, reward, and paper section ids are identical across runs
quiz.source_explanation: Determinism is part of the contract. Two runs with the same seed must produce the same artifacts. The test pins that.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 两次只核branch、reward6dp和section IDs，不能称所有artifact/report byte-identical；时间、路径、trace顺序与真实图/引文另验。

quiz.original: What does the demo report contain after a successful run?
original_options: Only the final LaTeX file
Just the experiment count and a status string
A model prompt and completion log
scheduler_report, best_branch, best_reward, critic_result, paper_manifest, and stop_reason
quiz.source_marked_answer: scheduler_report, best_branch, best_reward, critic_result, paper_manifest, and stop_reason
quiz.source_explanation: Every stage's output is preserved. The report is a composition of upstream outputs, not a transformed summary. Downstream tooling reads the manifest; debuggers read the trace inside scheduler_report.
quiz.中文解释与必要修正: 报告六字段scheduler_report/best_branch/best_reward/critic_result/paper_manifest/stop_reason；这些是协议及synthetic产物，不证明图文件/文献/研究效果真实。
